title: Localized comparison source models preserve complex coproducts
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in universe u, with R-algebras A,B and an E=A tensor_R B-algebra C. Choose derived categories of R- and B-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let I be a type in u, M_j cochain complexes of A-modules, S another such complex, and s_j:M_j to S a colimiting cofan in the cochain-complex category. For arbitrary universal base-derived tensor cohomology models m_j of M_j and m_S of S [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], and every integer i, let F be termwise extension along A to E to C. There is a C-module isomorphism e from the coproduct of C tensor_E m_j.cohomology(i) to C tensor_E m_S.cohomology(i), such that for every j, coprojection_j followed by e.hom followed by m_S.localizedComparison(i) equals m_j.localizedComparison(i) followed by H^i(F(s_j)). No K-flatness or flatness assumption is made, and the empty family is included.

source.place: Tag 06Y6, derived change of rings, K-flat computation and independence of choices; coproduct specialization of Tag 0DJA(1). Official online versions read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06Y6 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0DJA.

proof.text: For every s_j choose the counit-compatible canonical transformation δ_j and E-linear cohomology map g_j from exists_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModelMap. These choices are uniquely fixed by universal counit compatibility and the displayed cohomology identification. Apply the canonical cofan theorem to obtain IsColimit of the cofan (mS.cohomology(i),g).

Extension J from E=A tensor_R B to C is a left adjoint, so isColimitCofanMkObjOfIsColimit maps the E-module cofan to the colimiting C-module cofan with legs J.map(g_j). Compare this cofan with the chosen coproduct using coconePointUniqueUpToIso. Its coprojection equation gives Sigma.ι_j followed by e.hom equals J.map(g_j), including the empty family.

For each j rewrite the coprojection followed by e.hom as J.map(g_j). Apply localized model-map naturality to δ_j and g_j to obtain precisely the required comparison equation. No flatness or target-homology coproduct assumption is used.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06Y6, K-flat computation and independence of the derived change of rings; coproduct argument with Tag 07D9 (injectives.tex); localized counit comparison in Tag 08IB and the calculation used in Tag 0DJA(1). Official pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06Y6, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07D9 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0DJA were read online on 2026-10-14 because the local Stacks checkout is absent.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localizedComparison_coproduct_source
    (R A B C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    {I : Type u} (M : I → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (S : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (s : ∀ j, M j ⟶ S)
    (hs : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S s))
    (m : ∀ j, BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (M j) C)
    (mS : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B S C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    ∃ e : (∐ fun j ↦ (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj
        ((m j).cohomology i)) ≅
      (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mS.cohomology i),
      ∀ j, Sigma.ι _ j ≫ e.hom ≫ mS.localizedComparison i =
        (m j).localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map (s j)) i
